description: POST documents or text chunks plus a token budget. Returns deduplicated, query-ranked, whitespace-compressed context that fits the budget, with source offsets and a token estimate. Deterministic, no LLM. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
